residual: The actor ends about 0.38 CETH and about 9 USDC short, so it spent pre-existing balances. The explorer data does not show those balances.
note: This looks like a FLI issuance trade. The actor takes WETH from the FLI pool and the USDC/WETH pool, wraps it into cETH, and sends it to the FLI contract. It receives USDC from that contract, sends the USDC to the 0x88e6 pool, and FLI is minted to the 0x151c pool to settle. It fails the strict arbitrage test because cETH and USDC come from non-pool contracts and the CETH and USDC legs do not net to zero. The sender nets about 0.0998 ETH against 0.0862 ETH gas (+0.0136), but the unexplained CETH and USDC shortfalls (about 0.01 ETH at rough prices) leave the sign of the profit uncertain.
